ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Advait Energy Transitions Limited reported strong H1 FY2026 results, highlighted by 160% consolidated revenue growth and a record INR1,000+ crore order book, reflecting successful diversification into Power Transmission and New & Renewable Energy. A key concern is the substantial increase in trade receivables (INR60 crore in H1) significantly outpacing profits, suggesting material working capital strain. This, combined with acknowledged lower incremental profit margins, poses a red flag for future cash flow and profitability sustainability without requiring additional funding.
